purpose: Five-task regression/adoption pilot of the audited named S/U/E integration; descriptive, not held out or confirmatory.
prior_exposure: Same five previously used tasks; no new sample selection.
stage_policy: Initial S then U then E; editing stays available after first U; run_tests/view_diff/submit available in every stage.
tools: Pinned ACR search, CodeStruct readCode/editCode with disclosed UTF-8 fixes, original str_replace/create_file.
validation: Official public SWE-bench pytest/Django command plus supplied argv; created/modified tests and runner options allowed. No gold directives or unrestricted shell.
submission: Optional native git pathspec selection; omit paths or deadline recovery includes all changes except patch.txt.
server_policy: Fresh native vLLM process per model on physical GPUs 2 then 3. Native caching within each batch; no per-task reset; same sampling and serve configs as prior staged pilot.
grading_schedule: Freeze all ten outputs, then official SWE-bench grading with no agent/evaluator overlap.
adaptation: No changes to source, prompts or settings mid-pilot; interrupted/empty tasks remain denominator five.
comparison_limit: Multiple disclosed adapter/prompt fixes differ; this pilot cannot isolate one fix or establish a new S/U/E algorithm contribution.
